card.name: Inside embryo-fetal and interleukin words
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the "O" in EMBRY-O before "-FETAL" or "LOGY", and to the "in" in interleuk-in before a hyphen and number. It is strongest in boxed warning headings.

modes.label: Interleukin names
modes.description: The ending "in" of interleukin before a hyphen and a number.

card.plain: It fires partway through the words embryo-fetal and interleukin when they are split into pieces.
